name: comp-453

frames.best_why: Menu is open with Orion ticked and Sigma and Dorado listed under the Databases crumb.

tagline: A breadcrumb crumb that opens into a list of databases to pick.
summary: A path starting at Databases whose next crumb is a dropdown showing a database glyph and the chosen name; opening it lists Orion, Sigma and Dorado with a tick on the current one.
appearance: The grey word Databases and a chevron lead to a rounded outlined control holding a small database icon, a name and a down arrow. Opening it shows a dark rounded menu of three names with the active one ticked at the right.
behaviour: Clicking the control drops the list beneath; hovering a name fills that row grey and choosing one updates the control's label. A check mark stays with the current choice.
demo_content: Databases, with the options Orion, Sigma and Dorado.
search_phrases: choose a database from the path
navigation trail that opens a list
switch between items in a breadcrumb
pick a record from a dropdown in nav
use_when: Letting people jump between sibling records while keeping the parent path visible.
avoid_when: When the choice is long: the menu holds only three hardcoded databases.
customise: The parent crumb, icon, three options and default value are written inside; real data means editing the select items. Trigger padding and width are classes.
weight_why: One small select and a short menu; only light open and hover transitions.

a11y.note: The trigger has an aria-label and a proper option list, and focus is visible; no reduced-motion handling for the menu.

polish_why: Neat crumb-to-select control with a clear menu and a tidy tick; small but well resolved.
